## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. SPY (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +3.54%) CORRECTION but Stocks vs Bonds (SPY/TLT 1W: +0.89% | 1M: +3.86%) ↑ rising and CPER (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.58%) ABOVE TREND confirm risk appetite while VXX (1W: +1.35% | 1M: -18.12%) RECOVERY shows 1M complacency.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +0.53%) CORRECTION vs LQD (1W: -1.57% | 1M: -0.76%) BELOW TREND indicate HYG/LQD pressure (↓ falling). Reflation/energy push: XLE (1W: +6.79% | 1M: -1.89%) RECOVERY and CPER ABOVE TREND (↑ rising) supporting cyclicals.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tighter bias: Dollar strength (Level up; Dollar 1W: +0.35% | 1M: +1.97%) ↑ rising and TLT (1W: -1.73% | 1M: -0.71%) BELOW TREND point to higher rates and a flatter curve. Yield curve (Level 1.0267) BELOW TREND and Duration Preference BELOW TREND support modest tightening.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals/value leading: XLE (1W: +6.79% | 1M: -1.89%) RECOVERY and XLF (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +7.73%) CORRECTION showing relative strength while XLK (1W: -1.25% | 1M: +2.75%) CORRECTION is lagging. Style: Value over Growth given Energy/Financials strength and tech weakness.

**5. US vs Global?**
US holding up: SPY (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +3.54%) CORRECTION with domestic breadth supportive; China showing patchy recovery with FXI (1W: +2.92% | 1M: -3.05%) RECOVERY while EEM (1W: -4.54% | 1M: +0.27%) CORRECTION underperforms. Europe/Japan remain below trend on 1M comparisons.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation cooling: IWM (1W: -1.81% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION, ARKK (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +7.16%) CORRECTION and IBIT (1W: -2.49% | 1M: +0.40%) CORRECTION show recent profit-taking and fading short-term risk appetite.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Reflation tone: CPER (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.58%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +15.17% | 1M: -10.61%) RECOVERY highlight industrial/energy demand while GLD (1W: -3.93% | 1M: -1.99%) BELOW TREND shows safe-haven selling.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy leadership intact but volatile: XLE (1W: +6.79% | 1M: -1.89%) RECOVERY with BNO RECOVERY on large weekly moves, while UNG (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND shows gas weakness.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Breadth 7/11 and Stocks vs Bonds ABOVE TREND (SPY/TLT 1W: +0.89% | 1M: +3.86%) ↑ rising plus CPER ABOVE TREND support a risk-on backdrop. DIVERGENCE: Major divergence across cores — SPY (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +3.54%) CORRECTION, XLK (1W: -1.25% | 1M: +2.75%) CORRECTION and XLF (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +7.73%) CORRECTION show 1W weakness vs 1M strength, signaling transitional momentum and warranting caution.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals/value ETFs showing strength: XLF (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +7.73%) CORRECTION, XLE (1W: +6.79% | 1M: -1.89%) RECOVERY and XLI (1W: -2.80% | 1M: +6.57%) CORRECTION. Reduce exposure to tech momentum: XLK (1W: -1.25% | 1M: +2.75%) CORRECTION and QQQ (1W: -1.53% | 1M: +2.71%) CORRECTION while monitoring bond signals (TLT 1W: -1.73% | 1M: -0.71%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +6.79% | 1M: -1.89%) RECOVERY, XLF (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +7.73%) CORRECTION, XBI (1W: -3.40% | 1M: +20.68%) CORRECTION for mean-reversion. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -1.25% | 1M: +2.75%) CORRECTION, QQQ (1W: -1.53% | 1M: +2.71%) CORRECTION, UNG (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +15.17% | 1M: -10.61%) RECOVERY and CPER (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.58%) ABOVE TREND if reflation news continues. BEARISH: GLD (1W: -3.93% | 1M: -1.99%) BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -9.54%) BELOW TREND on risk-on flows.

**13. Key Levels?**
Watch VXX ~20 as a complacency pivot (VXX 1W: +1.35% | 1M: -18.12%) RECOVERY; HYG/LQD near 0.80 for credit health (HYG 1W: -0.44% | 1M: +0.53% CORRECTION; LQD 1W: -1.57% | 1M: -0.76% BELOW TREND); XLK/XLF ratio ~3.23 for growth vs value inflection.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, supported by Stocks vs Bonds ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.89% | 1M: +3.86%) and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.58%). Energy (XLE) and Financials (XLF) showing strength while Tech (XLK) is in CORRECTION — monitor the major 1W vs 1M divergences across core ETFs.
